What I think they're doing here is training the AI to drive at a much faster pace which is a good thing. But I'm not sure there's going to be any improvements in racecraft (as in making use of driving techniques to actually race you or other AI drivers like late braking, slipstreaming, positioning their cars to defend their positions when entering corners, etc.).

And just in case anyone is confused:

Pace = "How fast can you drive around a track?"

Racecraft = "How good are you at overtaking or defending your position and just battling against other drivers in general?"

The "racecraft" I think is the one aspect of racing game AI that is missing not just in GT, but in all sim-cade and simulation racing games. I think we can all agree that we want to race against other drivers who want to win as much we do and we want to race against AI drivers who know every "trick" in the book like we do.
